page.content:
WCW's New World Order — Hogan's black-and-white heel turn, later imported.

How nWo connects

  • Character: Hulk Hogan — Hulk Hogan's Hollywood turn made him the face of the nWo.
  • Topic: WWE — WWE later imported nWo trademarks and nostalgia chapters after buying WCW.

What is nWo?

The nWo began in WCW when Hulk Hogan turned on the company. WWE later absorbed the trademarks and ran nWo nostalgia chapters, treating Hollywood Hogan as crossover lore.

Key threads lead to Hulk Hogan and WWE.
